verdict.rationale: Clerk documents Enterprise SSO over SAML and OIDC with IdPs such as Azure AD, Okta and Google Workspace, with user data synchronized into Clerk. Separately, it documents Organizations for multi-tenant B2B apps. Nothing in the evidence ties an SSO connection to a specific customer organization, and verified domains and just-in-time provisioning are not documented. missing for 10: per-organization SSO connection binding, verified domain configuration, explicit JIT provisioning into organizations, independent or hands-on corroboration.
